item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Susan Solves It: Scam silence
item.description: Tampa Bay 28 Reporter Susan El Khoury advises consumers to avoid clicking suspicious links, verify requests independently, and report scams to federal authorities even if no money is recovered.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man charged with murder after victim dies from attack at St. Pete park: SPPD
item.description: St. Petersburg police have charged a man with first-degree murder after the victim he attacked at a park died from his injuries, authorities said.
